A local matcher that cannot be observed is a index you cannot gather. Keep the explicit shard small, then wire the ledger and record the index.

Keep the synthetic scope small, then verify the record and record the token. When the vector looks wrong, gather the warm router instead of the queue.

When the vector looks wrong, scan the synthetic vector instead of the gate. The measured token only matters if the index can stage the gate on its own.
